faq.headline: Questions, deconstructed.
faq.q1: What exactly does Scam-Link Sentinel scan for?
faq.a1: Wallet drainers, typosquat domains, fake AI-investment dashboards, withdrawal-lock contracts, fake APY math, phishing kits, malicious mint pages, and Telegram impersonators — every rule documented from a real scam we've investigated.
faq.q2: Do I have to connect my wallet?
faq.a2: No. Ever. Scam-Link Sentinel never asks for a wallet connection, seed phrase, or KYC. You forward a link, you get a verdict. Sovereignty first.
faq.q3: How is this different from a normal URL checker?
faq.a3: Generic checkers look at SSL and blacklists. We look at on-chain heuristics, withdrawal-lock contract patterns, fake-APY math, and social-engineering schemas specifically engineered against crypto users.
faq.a4: Not yet. We're in private beta — no prices, no subscriptions, no "founder tier". When the bot opens, waitlist members get invites first. Any future pricing decisions happen after public launch and will be transparent.
faq.a5: @CryptoFixYup — an independent investigator documenting active crypto scams. Every rule in MYTHOS comes from a real case. The work, contact details and code repository are linked in the footer.
faq.a6: We open in invite waves to waitlist members. No fixed date — we ship when the engine is honest about what it can and can't catch.
